evidenceRules: Footage proves only visible presentation and observable interaction; it does not prove asset IDs, UI instance hierarchy, data schema or backend behavior.
Visible 2x playback segments prohibit uncorrected animation, transition, input or movement timing comparisons.
Player-authored nameplates and sample balances are not required product copy or seed data.
Approximate recording bounds are measured against the full 1112x512 recording; dark side bars are recording framing, and target devices must apply their own safe-area insets.
Derived PNG hashes identify this extraction only; the pinned MP4 SHA-256 values remain the source identities.

observed: The dealership consumes the full gameplay viewport as a split surface: a large left preview/instruction pane and a blue right browse pane.
The recurring right action rail is not visible while this dealership surface is open; compact weather/day/time remains visible above it in the Roblox top bar area.
Visible labels include Large Motor Dealership, Buy a new car here!, All, Vehicles, Skins, Search and Sort by.
At B@00:45 the selected RHS Fan Car exposes Standard, Vehicle, Top Speed: 60, Acceleration: 15 and descriptive copy inside the browse pane while the left pane still says Select an Item.
The right pane retains surrounding vehicle cards and prices plus two displayed balance fields in the footer.
B@00:50 and B@00:55 show a separate Buy House panel; this establishes only a later panel state, not the input or backend transition that caused it.
inferenceLimits: Do not require an animated or 3D preview to change on selection; the sampled selected state keeps the left preview instruction visible.
Do not infer the complete vehicle catalog, currency names, asset IDs, ownership, purchase/spawn protocol or selection event hierarchy.
The hidden rail in this state does not prove it is destroyed; only that it is not simultaneously visible in the sampled frame.

travel.source: C@00:02 free roam, C@00:05 Travel open, C@00:08 Travel open with category strip
observed: Travel opens as a centered blue modal while the compact top-right status, right action rails and bottom shortcuts remain visible around it.
Visible top tabs are Locations and Servers; the modal keeps a clear close control.
Visible destination tiles include Campsite, Lake, Club Red, Sunblox Cafe, Chef Umbra's and Maisy's Mystical Dining.
C@00:08 visibly includes a category strip with Neighborhood, Outskirts and Forest; lower tile rows are partially clipped by the sampled frame.
inferenceLimits: Do not treat the sampled labels/order as an exhaustive destination catalog.
Do not infer image asset IDs, travel costs, unlock requirements, server browser behavior or transport backend.
Do not copy recording coordinates directly to a phone or tablet; preserve the relationships after device safe-area insets.

jobResult.source: C@01:02 and C@01:05 result state; C@01:08 subsequent Jobs detail state
observed: The centered Jobs result modal leaves the top-right status, right rails and bottom shortcuts visible.

Visible result text identifies Servant of the Void - Hard, Performance, Excellent! (7 Items Collected), Earnings, +66, +664 XP, 9 Levels to Promotion (Professional), a Gift Box message and one OK action.
The result dialog separates performance, two earnings fields, promotion progress and reward copy.
C@01:08 shows a subsequent Jobs detail/difficulty panel rather than a direct free-roam-only frame.
inferenceLimits: Do not infer reward formula, grade thresholds, currency identity, save timing or promotion rules from one result.
The top status values in the sampled result frame do not establish whether or when +66 or +664 XP was durably credited.
Do not require OK to return directly to free roam; the observed sequence includes a Jobs detail state after the result.

acceptance: Use a compact right-edge action rail, compact top-right read-only status stack and separated bottom-center shortcuts.
Remove the permanent 236x184 LegacySchoolMenu from the open world view; schedule/class detail remains reachable on demand.
Keep the lower-left movement area, lower-right camera/jump area and center world view unobstructed after applying device safe-area insets.
At most one large feature panel is open at a time.
Panel fits inside the current device safe area, remains dismissible, and does not leave feature actions stranded off-screen.
Closing the panel restores the compact edge HUD without changing server state.
Use a responsive split surface within the safe gameplay viewport: preview/instruction region plus blue browsing region with category, search/sort, cards, selected details and server-read balances.
A selected item must expose a legible detail state, but the reference does not require the left preview to animate or change.
The sampled dealership may replace the free-roam right rail while open; close remains reachable and returns to a safe compact HUD state.
Selection changes read-only presentation only; purchase/spawn requires a separate explicit server-authoritative action.
No automatic spend, client-authored price, client-authored ownership or invented vehicle asset ID.
Centered Travel modal preserves the visible top-right status, right rails and bottom shortcuts without covering its close control.
Locations/Servers tabs and image tiles remain legible; category strips may appear inside the modal.
Destination selection is an explicit tap and transport remains server-confirmed.
Unknown destinations/images remain placeholders or absent until verified; no inferred asset IDs, cost or unlock state.
Centered result dialog preserves the edge HUD and visibly separates job/difficulty, performance, earnings, promotion progress, reward copy and dismissal.
Dismissal may lead to the observed Jobs detail state; do not hard-code a direct free-roam return solely from this sample.
Reward is displayed from an authoritative server receipt and cannot be claimed twice by replaying the client dialog.
No reward formula, grade threshold, currency identity or durable commit timing is inferred from one result.

desktopLandscape: Compare against cropped game viewport rather than recording side bars.
Right rail and top-right status remain compact; world center/left has no permanent large menu.
phoneLandscape: Apply current safe-area/top-bar insets instead of copying desktop recording coordinates.
Movement thumb zone and camera/jump controls remain unobstructed while all four primary rail actions are reachable.
Bottom shortcuts remain above platform controls and do not overlap the active vehicle or activity controls.
tabletLandscape: Do not scale panels to fill the larger canvas unnecessarily; preserve compact rail/status density.
Housing editor, dealership and Travel grids use available width without exceeding safe-area bounds.
requiredEvidence: Exact-candidate rendered screenshots in free roam, dealership, Travel and job-result states.
Separate visual, interaction and device statuses; static CI alone cannot pass rendered parity.
Successful open/close and state-refresh checks on iPhone and iPad form factors before parity claims.
Viewport-relative comparison uses the measured B/C relationships, not literal recording coordinates.

All recording bounds are approximate evidence coordinates; pass/fail on target devices is relationship- and safe-area-based, not literal-pixel cloning.
